from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document parsed from the collection, containing metadata needed to classify its case type."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document, e.g. '《判决文书 a》'")
    procedural_focus: str = Field(description="The primary procedural issue or stage, e.g. 'Jurisdiction Objection', 'Execution Reconsideration', 'State Compensation Decision', 'Administrative Trial'")
    case_subject_matter: str = Field(description="The underlying legal subject matter or dispute type, e.g. 'Construction Contract', 'Administrative Information Disclosure', 'Labor Contract'")
    defendant_or_authority: str = Field(description="The opposing party or decision-making authority, e.g. 'Emergency Management Bureau', 'Compensation Committee', 'Defendant Company'")
    applicable_laws: list[str] = Field(description="List of specific laws cited in the document, e.g. 'Administrative Procedure Law', 'State Compensation Law'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
